about: Prototype module panels rendered by the PWA shell. These are Localizer draft cards, not clinical approval.

cards.imageDesc: Hands under clean running water with soap bubbles and a simple 20-second clock.
cards.cacheNote: Timer card is tiny enough for 1 GB devices; no background alert is assumed. Nudge timing is brokered centrally; this card declares intent only.

cards.imageDesc: Caregiver marking day boxes beside a zinc blister pack and ORS cup.
cards.cacheNote: 10-day course tracker is prototype-only and must match local zinc product guidance. Nudge timing is brokered centrally; this card declares intent only.

cards.imageDesc: Child and caregiver with toothbrush, small toothpaste cue, two-minute timer, morning/night stars, and tune button.
cards.cacheNote: Reference toothbrushing slice: foreground timer, synthetic star chart, and prototype tune control. Nudge timing is brokered centrally; this card declares intent only.

cards.imageDesc: Covered water container with a chlorine bottle, marked dose, and 30-minute wait clock.
cards.cacheNote: Dose text is intentionally omitted until local chlorine product instructions are approved.

cards.imageDesc: Covered pot at a rolling boil beside a one-minute clock.
cards.cacheNote: Prototype uses conservative education language; altitude/local guidance needs review.

cards.imageDesc: Caregiver holding a newborn skin-to-skin under a wrap, with a gentle session timer.
cards.cacheNote: Supportive timer only; newborn danger signs and health-worker guidance override.

cards.imageDesc: Household checklist with water, ORS, phone/clinic contact, and transport symbols.
cards.cacheNote: Checklist is non-clinical preparedness support and can run fully offline.

cards.imageDesc: New mother seated comfortably with baby positioned close, plus audio and CHW support icons.
cards.cacheNote: Prototype read-aloud script with breastfeeding difficulty plus danger signs routed to health-worker support.

cards.imageDesc: Household water alert with safe water, handwashing, latrine, ORS, and clinic referral icons.
cards.cacheNote: Prototype alert is local-only; background phone alerts may not work while asleep. Nudge timing is brokered centrally; this card declares intent only.

cards.imageDesc: Consent-aware learning dashboard with opt-in, no real names, and review-board check icons.
cards.cacheNote: Synthetic-data prototype only; no real research data collection until ethics and security approvals exist.

cards.imageDesc: Quality dashboard with source, comparison, and approval columns.
cards.cacheNote: 8 GB profile only for now because it will later load richer comparison tables and review artifacts.

cards.imageDesc: Pregnant person reviewing visit dates, transport plan, facility contact, and birth companion options.
cards.cacheNote: No clinical visit schedule is generated until local ANC schedule is approved. Nudge timing is brokered centrally; this card declares intent only.

cards.imageDesc: Caregiver holding a child vaccination card beside a calendar.
cards.cacheNote: WHO-style prototype date calculation; exact local dates must be confirmed against the child vaccine card and approved local EPI schedule. Nudge timing is brokered centrally; this card declares intent only.

cards.imageDesc: New mother and baby visit checklist with CHW/clinic contact and danger-sign reminder.
cards.cacheNote: Routine postnatal reminders need local schedule and newborn/maternal review. Nudge timing is brokered centrally; this card declares intent only.

cards.imageDesc: Medicine refill calendar with an optional photo of a medicine box, prescription, or bottle.
cards.cacheNote: Non-dosing calendar reminder only; medicine changes require clinician/pharmacist advice. An optional reference photo is held only for the current app session and is not shown on Home. The PWA sends a private in-app request through the shared Nudge Coordinator.

cards.imageDesc: Labor timing support visual with a foreground clock, clinic arrow, local threshold, transport buffer, and danger override.
cards.cacheNote: Life-critical feature; native validation and SMS reliability required before real use.

cards.imageDesc: Caregiver tucking a bednet around a sleeping area with a repair reminder and malaria-prevention cue.
cards.cacheNote: Prevention reminder only; fever/malaria care follows local guidance. Nudge timing is brokered centrally; this card declares intent only.

cards.imageDesc: Caregiver watching a tired child with cup, water bottle, and dehydration concern cues; not a diagnosis image.
cards.cacheNote: Danger signs first; no diagnosis or dehydration classification in this prototype card.

cards.imageDesc: Caregiver feeding a young child from a bowl with varied foods, cup, and handwashing cue.
cards.cacheNote: Nutrition counseling support only; local growth and feeding protocols control.

cards.imageDesc: Covered water container and unbranded chlorine product beside a local-table checklist; no generic dose.
cards.cacheNote: Uses only user-entered local table or label values; does not invent dose.

cards.imageDesc: Household WASH scene with latrine, handwashing, and child-stool disposal cues.
cards.cacheNote: WASH checklist only; local sanitation program guidance controls.

cards.imageDesc: Message examples for app card, SMS, IVR, WhatsApp, and CHW script variants from one approved content object.
cards.cacheNote: No live SMS, IVR, WhatsApp, or outbound messaging in the prototype.

cards.imageDesc: Caregiver and health worker at a clinic doorway with contact card, phone, saved status, retry, and closure cues.
cards.cacheNote: Synthetic local queue only; no live messaging, call center, or facility feedback loop.

cards.imageDesc: Shared phone with shield, quick-hide cue, neutral notification, private labels, opt-out, export, and delete choices.
cards.cacheNote: Prototype does not secure real sensitive data; production needs secure Device storage and consent controls.

cards.imageDesc: Health worker and supervisor reviewing privacy-safe aggregate charts for source status, language readiness, referral closure, and service quality.
cards.cacheNote: Aggregate synthetic dashboard only; no individual surveillance or production analytics.
